name: Lateness
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of timely action and readiness, teaching that there is a proper season for every purpose under heaven (Ecclesiastes 3:1). Proverbs warns against laziness and delay, illustrating that those who neglect to work during the appropriate time bring shame and want (Proverbs 10:5; 20:4). The New Testament reinforces this principle through the parable of the ten virgins, urging believers to keep their lamps burning and be prepared to meet the bridegroom at the appointed time (Matthew 25:1; Luke 12:35). Jesus’ teaching about walking in the daylight highlights the wisdom of acting within the proper time to avoid stumbling (John 11:9).
